title: Guidance to Listed Firms on Fair Contracting of Freelancers Outlined in Tripartite Standard
what_it_is: Guidance to Listed Firms on Fair Contracting of Freelancers Outlined in Tripartite Standard

sections.label: Tripartite Standard adoption outreach
sections.summary: Over 2,600 companies adopted the Tripartite Standard, and TAFEP will work with NTUC's Freelancers and Self-Employed Unit and associations to reach more companies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Today, more than 2,600 companies have adopted this Tripartite Standard.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Tripartite Alliance For Fair and Progressive Employment Practices (TAFEP) will continue to work with the National Trades Union Congress (NTUC)'s Freelancers and Self-Employed Unit and explore partnerships with relevant associations to strengthen outreach to companies, including listed companies, on the Tripartite Standard and its practices.

sections.label: Follow-through on adopted standards
sections.summary: Outreach helps companies understand the standards, parties should abide by signed contracts, and disputes can be surfaced to TAFEP or TADM for action.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: For the second supplementary question on steps to ensure follow-through, I think that it is important that we continue to reach out to companies that are adopting these standards to help them understand what these standards are trying to achieve, what the standards entail, so that they understand the reasons behind adopting these practices and hope that both parties will abide by the contracts that they have signed, and ensure that if there are any disputes to the contract terms that have been signed, they can surface to TAFEP or Tripartite Alliance for Dispute Management (TADM), whichever the agency would be.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: And we can take actions against companies who may have violated their contracts.

sections.label: Company adoption numbers over years
sections.summary: Adoption rose from about 470 companies in 2018 to about 1,800 in 2020 and 2,600 in 2023, with companies adopting standards to be better buyers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: For example, in 2018, when we first rolled out this standard, there were nearly about 470 companies that came on board these standards.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In the year 2020, it increased to about 1,800 companies.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: And then, in the year 2023, it further increased to 2,600 companies.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, I think, beyond the Public Service taking the lead, companies are indeed coming on board and adopting these standards to be better buyers of services.
